name: pathiel-dex
description: On-chain route solver for Base. Quotes every venue from pool state, solves the optimal split, and proves its quotes against real fills on a mainnet fork. No aggregator API, no keys.

paragraphs: An on-chain route solver for Robinhood Chain, Base and X Layer, with one account across all three and Hyperliquid's stock perps. It quotes every major venue directly from pool state — direct pools and two-hop routes alike — solves the optimal split across them, and executes through the venues' own audited routers.

Nothing asks which chain. You name an asset and an amount of dollars; the router prices every chain that lists it, spends dollars from wherever the account holds them, crosses when crossing pays, and buys the gas it needs on the way. The chain a trade landed on is shown afterwards, never demanded beforehand. The pages that exist to compare chains — venues, depth, tools, backtests — carry their own chain control, and the API and MCP tools still take chain=robinhood|base|xlayer.

There is no aggregator API anywhere in it, and no API key of any kind. Prices come from pool reserves and quoter contracts read over public RPC, which is what makes the central claim checkable: the router's off-chain quote is compared against a real fill on a mainnet fork, and has to match.

requirements.text: You name an asset and an amount of dollars; the router prices every chain that lists it, spends dollars from wherever the account holds them, crosses when crossing pays, and buys the gas it needs on the way.
Sign in with your wallet, sign one message, deposit once, and trade Base, Robinhood Chain, X Layer and Hyperliquid perps from a single balance — no chain selector and no wallet popup per trade.
Comparing a split to a single route needs both sides in one unit, and the extra cost is in ETH while the benefit is in the token being bought.
